description: Curated, source-linked historical context. These records are not evidence that a relationship or product remains active today.

records.relationship: Ripple reported that a 12-bank R3 consortium was trialing XRP for cross-border payments and liquidity.
records.status: historical; trial does not establish current production use

records.relationship: Ripple announced these financial institutions had joined its payment network and described successful real-money pilots. This announcement concerned Ripple's network, not proof that every institution used XRP.
records.classification: Ripple network relationship; XRP use not established by this source
records.status: historical; current product and relationship status requires fresh confirmation

records.relationship: American Express FX International Payments worked with Ripple and Santander UK on a blockchain-enabled US-to-UK business payment channel through Ripple's network.
records.classification: Ripple network/payment-channel relationship; XRP use not established by this source
records.status: historical announcement; do not assume ongoing service

records.relationship: MoneyGram announced a plan to use XRP in payment flows through xRapid, later associated with On-Demand Liquidity (ODL); Ripple reported Bitso as a key exchange partner for the US-Mexico corridor. MoneyGram suspended use of Ripple's platform in February 2021. Ripple and MoneyGram announced on March 8, 2021 that they had decided to end their current partnership agreement; Ripple's statement page is dated March 9. Both companies said they were committed to revisiting the relationship in the future.
records.classification: XRP/ODL commercial use with explicit end-of-partnership record
records.status: platform use suspended in February 2021; decision to end the current partnership announced March 8, 2021 (Ripple statement page dated March 9); both companies said they were committed to revisiting the relationship. This does not establish a later renewed partnership.

records.relationship: Ripple reported more than two dozen ODL customers and named goLance, Viamericas, FlashFX, and Interbank Peru among customers committed to using ODL. ODL was described as using XRP as a bridge asset; this is a historical snapshot.
records.status: historical; current customer status and live corridors require fresh confirmation

records.relationship: Ripple announced an agreement to acquire a 40% stake in Tranglo, describing the relationship as supporting cross-border payments and expanding ODL corridors using XRP.
records.status: historical announcement; do not infer current ownership percentage, operations, or corridor activity without newer evidence

records.relationship: Ripple and the Republic of Palau announced a partnership to explore a digital-currency strategy, cross-border payments, and a possible USD-backed digital currency with use cases on the XRP Ledger.
records.classification: government partnership/exploration; not proof of a launched national stablecoin
records.status: historical exploration announcement; implementation and current status require fresh confirmation

records.relationship: Ripple's own explanation states that the XRP Ledger is decentralized and would continue to exist if Ripple ceased to exist. Ripple is a company; XRP is the digital asset; XRPL is the ledger/network. They are related but not interchangeable.
records.status: foundational context; use to avoid conflating company, asset, and network

records.relationship: Ripple announced a live On-Demand Liquidity implementation connecting SBI Remit with Coins.ph and SBI VC Trade for Japan-to-Philippines remittances; Ripple explicitly described XRP as the digital asset used to avoid pre-funding.
records.classification: XRP-specific live ODL deployment announced by Ripple
records.status: historical launch evidence; current corridor, volumes, counterparties, and ongoing XRP usage require newer confirmation

records.relationship: Ripple announced RLUSD would become available on global exchanges from December 17, 2024, describing it as a USD-denominated stablecoin backed by dollar deposits, U.S. government bonds, and cash equivalents.
records.status: launch announcement; current supply, reserve composition, distribution, and use must be verified from newer disclosures; RLUSD is not XRP

records.relationship: Ripple announced RLUSD integration into Ripple Payments and named BKK Forex and iSend as select customers using it in payment flows for cross-border treasury operations.
records.classification: stablecoin integration into enterprise payments; not evidence that XRP was the settlement asset in these flows
records.status: historical launch/use snapshot; current customers and flow composition require fresh confirmation

entities: The Bank of New York Mellon
aliases: The Bank of New York Mellon
records.relationship: Ripple announced that BNY was selected for primary custody of RLUSD reserves.
records.classification: institutional stablecoin-reserve custody relationship; not evidence of BNY using XRP for settlement
records.status: announced July 2025; verify current custody arrangements and scope from newer evidence

records.relationship: DBS, Franklin Templeton, and Ripple announced an MoU for trading and lending solutions involving Franklin Templeton's tokenized money-market fund on the XRP Ledger and stablecoins including RLUSD; the announcement described sgBENJI trading on DBS Digital Exchange and exploring token use as collateral.
records.classification: tokenized fund and stablecoin institutional initiative on XRPL; not evidence that XRP itself is the fund settlement or collateral asset
records.status: announced MoU and planned/exploratory solutions; do not treat all proposed functionality as launched without newer confirmation

records.relationship: Ripple and Securitize announced smart-contract functionality allowing holders of BlackRock's BUIDL and VanEck's VBILL tokenized funds to exchange shares for RLUSD; Ripple also said Securitize was integrating with XRPL to expand access.
records.classification: tokenized fund liquidity/off-ramp integration using RLUSD; not proof of XRP use as settlement asset
records.status: announcement said BUIDL support was available and VBILL support would follow; verify present implementation and supported chains before claiming current scope
